title: The Safe Room Ship Crews Hide In When Pirates Board
asof: Rules from MLC 2006 · data as of 2025 · full video on the channel

shots.s: If pirates board this ship, the crew has one place to go.
A locked safe room deep inside the ship.
Guidance says it should hold food and water for at least three days.
In November 2025, pirates boarded a tanker off Somalia.
All twenty-four crew locked themselves in.
Would you wait it out in there?
